observations: Large green-painted inline multi-cylinder diesel engine photographed outdoors on a wooden pallet.
Flywheel housing heavily rusted and caked with dirt/mud.
A metal emblem/badge is visible on the side of the block but text is too small/blurred to read in this photo.
Engine is surrounded by other equipment (a genset, tanks) suggesting a scrapyard or engine-dealer yard.
No oil, coolant, exhaust smoke or running video evident; engine appears static and uncleaned.
No serial/data plate, hour-meter, or close-up of any identifying tag is visible.

No import documents, shipping labels, or paperwork shown in the photo.
No video or audio of the engine running; engine is shown static, dirty, and disconnected from any load.
No hour-meter or logbook photo provided.
No photos of sealed bolts, untouched gaskets, or service stickers to confirm this.

risks.risk: Engine may not actually run or may have internal wear/knock despite claim.
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine starting, idling, and revving with audible sound.

risks.risk: Corrosion or water ingress typical of marine use, especially given visible rust on flywheel housing.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of cylinder bores, injectors removed, and internal inspection ports.

risks.risk: No verifiable model/serial plate, so exact Detroit 671 identity and spec (HP, year) cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the engine data plate or stamped serial number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unidentified industrial diesel engine

risks.risk: Import/Tokunbo claim unverifiable, could affect provenance and duty status.

risks.if_unproven: priced as locally sourced used engine, no import premium

proof_requests: Video of the engine running (start-up, idle, rev) with audible sound.
Clear close-up photo of the data/serial plate confirming 'Detroit 671' or 'Detroit Diesel 6-71'.
Photos of internal components (injectors, head, bores) or a compression test result.
Any import/customs documentation supporting the Belgium/Tokunbo claim.
Photo of hour-meter or maintenance log if available.
response.reason: The photo confirms a large diesel engine of the general size/class seen in industrial engine listings, but the model, running condition, and import claims are all unverified, so it must be priced at worst case as an unproven, possibly non-running industrial diesel engine comparable to mid-range industrial units.
